feature_summary.description: Admin-only tool for uploading Excel + ZIP of resumes for controlled production-grade candidate data seeding
key_components: Backend: POST /api/admin/bulk-import/parse - parse Excel + ZIP, return merged data for review
Backend: POST /api/admin/bulk-import/save - save reviewed candidates to Candidate Bank
Backend: GET /api/admin/bulk-import/batches - list all import batches for audit
Frontend: BulkImportPage.jsx - complete UI with upload, preview, confirm flow
data_flow: 2. Admin fills template with candidate metadata
3. Admin creates ZIP with resume files (PDF/DOC/DOCX)
4. Admin uploads both files and clicks Parse & Preview
5. System parses Excel, extracts resumes from ZIP, uploads to R2
6. System parses resumes with AI for enrichment
8. Admin reviews merged data, selects candidates to import
10. System saves to Candidate Bank with source='bulk_import' and import_batch_id
validation_rules: Required: Email OR Phone (at least one)
Required: Resume file matching resume_filename column
Warnings: Missing location, salary, notice period
